prompt: Ok the grill is done. Here's what we agreed: we're adding a Stripe webhook handler to an Express/TypeScript app. The handler validates the Stripe signature, identifies the event type, and updates the order status in the DB. Files we're touching: src/middleware/webhookSignature.ts (already has pseudocode), src/webhooks/StripeWebhookController.ts (create), src/services/OrderService.ts (update — add updateStatus method), src/repositories/OrderRepository.ts (update — add findByStripePaymentId and updateStatus). Edge cases: duplicate events must be idempotent (use event ID), invalid signature → 400, unknown event type → log and 200, order not found → log and 200 (don't fail Stripe), DB failure → 500. Break this into tickets.

assertions.text: Tickets are ordered in dependency order — repository before service before controller
Every ticket has a verb-first title
Acceptance criteria reference the specific edge cases from the grill (idempotency, invalid signature, unknown event type, order not found)
Asks the engineer to confirm the breakdown before starting
Each ticket touches no more than 3 files
